Hummingbird: needle, link, beak shot

Small and bright, to read apart from the heavy machines. The heal is the warm one; the beak shot stays tiny because it repeats all fight. The link hum is a quiet loop that holds while the ruby beam is up. Every A is in the game now as a placeholder. Pick a letter per sound, or "all A" / "all B".

In a fight

Needle, all A

cast and heal, cast and hit, cast and miss

3400 ms, peak -2.9 dBFS

Link, all A

lock on, hum 3 s, snap

4000 ms, peak -2.2 dBFS

Beak shot, all A

three shots 0.9 s apart: hit, hit, miss

2600 ms, peak -2.1 dBFS

3400 ms, peak -1.4 dBFS
